import sys
from collections import deque

A = 26
INF = 0x3f3f3f3f

class MinCostFlow:
    def __init__(self, n, max_edge):
        self.n = n
        self.max_edge = max_edge
        self.node_cnt = 1 + n + A + 1
        self.edge_cnt = 0
        self.next_arc = [0] * (1 + max_edge * 2)
        self.arc_edge = [0] * (1 + max_edge * 2)
        self.arc_cnt = 1
        self.from_ = [0] * max_edge
        self.to = [0] * max_edge
        self.cap = [0] * (max_edge << 1)
        self.org_cost = [0] * max_edge
        self.red_cost = [0] * max_edge
        self.head = [0] * self.node_cnt
        self.dist = [0] * self.node_cnt
        self.depth = [0] * self.node_cnt
        self.prev_arc = [0] * self.node_cnt
        self.heap = [0] * (self.node_cnt + 1)
        self.heap_pos = [0] * self.node_cnt
        self.heap_size = 0

    def add_arc(self, head, e):
        self.next_arc[self.arc_cnt] = head
        self.arc_edge[self.arc_cnt] = e
        self.arc_cnt += 1
        return self.arc_cnt - 1

    def add_edge(self, u, v, c, w):
        h = self.edge_cnt
        self.edge_cnt += 1
        self.from_[h] = u
        self.to[h] = v
        self.cap[h << 1] = c
        self.org_cost[h] = w
        self.head[u] = self.add_arc(self.head[u], h << 1)
        self.head[v] = self.add_arc(self.head[v], h << 1 | 1)

    def better(self, u, v):
        return self.dist[u] < self.dist[v] or (self.dist[u] == self.dist[v] and self.depth[u] < self.depth[v])

    def min_child(self, i):
        i *= 2
        if i > self.heap_size:
            return 0
        if i < self.heap_size and self.better(self.heap[i + 1], self.heap[i]):
            return i + 1
        return i

    def heap_up(self, u):
        i = self.heap_pos[u]
        while True:
            j = i // 2
            if j == 0 or not self.better(u, self.heap[j]):
                break
            v = self.heap[j]
            self.heap[self.heap_pos[v] = i] = v
            i = j
        self.heap[self.heap_pos[u] = i] = u

    def heap_down(self, u):
        i = self.heap_pos[u]
        while True:
            j = self.min_child(i)
            if j == 0 or not self.better(self.heap[j], u):
                break
            v = self.heap[j]
            self.heap[self.heap_pos[v] = i] = v
            i = j
        self.heap[self.heap_pos[u] = i] = u

    def heap_add(self, u):
        self.heap_size += 1
        self.heap_pos[u] = self.heap_size
        self.heap[self.heap_size] = u

    def heap_remove(self):
        u = self.heap[1]
        v = self.heap[self.heap_size]
        self.heap_size -= 1
        if v != u:
            self.heap_pos[v] = 1
            self.heap_down(v)
        self.heap_pos[u] = 0
        return u

    def dijkstra(self, s, t):
        self.dist = [INF] * self.node_cnt
        self.dist[s] = 0
        self.heap_add(s)
        while self.heap_size > 0:
            u = self.heap_remove()
            nd = self.depth[u] + 1
            a = self.head[u]
            while a != 0:
                eid = self.arc_edge[a]
                if self.cap[eid] <= 0:
                    a = self.next_arc[a]
                    continue
                h = eid >> 1
                v = u ^ self.from_[h] ^ self.to[h]
                ndist = self.dist[u] + (self.red_cost[h] if (eid & 1) == 0 else -self.red_cost[h])
                if ndist < self.dist[v] or (ndist == self.dist[v] and self.depth[v] > nd):
                    if self.dist[v] == INF:
                        self.heap_add(v)
                    self.dist[v] = ndist
                    self.depth[v] = nd
                    self.prev_arc[v] = eid
                    self.heap_up(v)
                a = self.next_arc[a]
        return self.dist[t] != INF

    def augment(self, s, t):
        flow = 0
        while t != s:
            eid = self.prev_arc[t]
            h = eid >> 1
            self.cap[eid] -= 1
            self.cap[eid ^ 1] += 1
            t ^= self.from_[h] ^ self.to[h]
            flow += 1
        return flow

    def min_cost_flow(self, s, t):
        for h in range(self.edge_cnt):
            u = self.from_[h]
            v = self.to[h]
            self.dist[v] = min(self.dist[v], self.dist[u] + self.org_cost[h])
        for h in range(self.edge_cnt):
            u = self.from_[h]
            v = self.to[h]
            self.red_cost[h] = self.org_cost[h] + self.dist[u] - self.dist[v]
        flow_cost = 0
        while self.dijkstra(s, t):
            flow_cost += self.augment(s, t)
            for h in range(self.edge_cnt):
                u = self.from_[h]
                v = self.to[h]
                if self.dist[u] != INF and self.dist[v] != INF:
                    self.red_cost[h] += self.dist[u] - self.dist[v]
        ans = 0
        for h in range(self.edge_cnt):
            ans += self.cap[h << 1 | 1] * self.org_cost[h]
        return ans

def run():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it)) // 2
    max_edge = n + n * A + A
    mcf = MinCostFlow(n, max_edge)
    s = next(it).strip()
    b = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(2 * n)]

    for i in range(n):
        mcf.add_edge(0, 1 + i, 2, 0)
    for i in range(n):
        j = 2 * n - 1 - i
        ai = ord(s[i]) - 97
        aj = ord(s[j]) - 97
        for a in range(A):
            if a == ai and a == aj:
                w = max(b[i], b[j])
            elif a == ai:
                w = b[i]
            elif a == aj:
                w = b[j]
            else:
                w = 0
            mcf.add_edge(1 + i, 1 + n + a, 1, -w)
    cnt = [0] * A
    for i in range(2 * n):
        cnt[ord(s[i]) - 97] += 1
    for a in range(A):
        mcf.add_edge(1 + n + a, mcf.node_cnt - 1, cnt[a], 0)

    result = -mcf.min_cost_flow(0, mcf.node_cnt - 1)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
